import zipfile,re
z=zipfile.ZipFile('inputs/offer_letter_template.docx')
# find which parts reference placeholders / conditionals
import re
for n in z.namelist():
    if n.endswith('.xml'):
        data=z.read(n).decode('utf-8',errors='replace')
        toks=set(re.findall(r'[A-Z][A-Z_]{2,}',data))
        interesting=[t for t in toks if 'RELOC' in t or 'IF_' in t or t in ('CUSTODIAN_NAME','EQUIPMENT_DESCRIPTION','RECORD_CODE','ORGANIZATION_NAME','ISSUE_DATE','OWNER_NAME','ADDRESS_LINE','DETAIL_NOTE','RELOCATION_AMOUNT')]
        if interesting:
            print(n, sorted(interesting))

import zipfile,re
z=zipfile.ZipFile('inputs/offer_letter_template.docx')
parts=['word/document.xml','word/header1.xml','word/header2.xml','word/header3.xml','word/header4.xml','word/header5.xml','word/header6.xml','word/footer1.xml','word/footer2.xml','word/footer3.xml','word/footer4.xml','word/footer5.xml','word/footer6.xml']
for p in parts:
    data=z.read(p).decode('utf-8')
    # per paragraph text
    paras=re.findall(r'<w:p[ >].*?</w:p>',data,re.S)
    for i,para in enumerate(paras):
        texts=re.findall(r'<w:t[^>]*>(.*?)</w:t>',para,re.S)
        txt=''.join(texts)
        if re.search(r'[A-Z]{3,}|IF_|RELOC',txt):
            print(f"{p} [{i}] :: {txt!r}")

cd /workspace && python3 - <<'PY'
import zipfile,re
zi=zipfile.ZipFile('inputs/offer_letter_template.docx')
zo=zipfile.ZipFile('output/offer_letter_filled.docx')
print("namelist identical:", zi.namelist()==zo.namelist())
parts=['word/document.xml']+[f'word/header{i}.xml' for i in range(1,7)]+[f'word/footer{i}.xml' for i in range(1,7)]
for p in parts:
    data=zo.read(p).decode('utf-8')
    paras=re.findall(r'<w:p[ >].*?</w:p>',data,re.S)
    for i,para in enumerate(paras):
        txt=''.join(re.findall(r'<w:t[^>]*>(.*?)</w:t>',para,re.S))
        if txt.strip():
            print(f"{p}[{i}]: {txt!r}")
    # integrity checks
    assert '{{' not in data, f"leftover placeholder in {p}"
# structural counts
for p in parts:
    a=zi.read(p).decode('utf-8'); b=zo.read(p).decode('utf-8')
    assert a.count('<w:tbl>')==b.count('<w:tbl>'), f"table count diff {p}"
    assert a.count('<w:tc>')==b.count('<w:tc>'), f"cell count diff {p}"
    assert a.count('<w:p>')+a.count('<w:p ')==b.count('<w:p>')+b.count('<w:p '), f"para count diff {p}"
    assert a.count('<w:sectPr')==b.count('<w:sectPr'), f"sectPr diff {p}"
print("ALL STRUCTURE CHECKS PASSED")

    for i,para in enumerate(re.findall(r'<w:p[ >].*?</w:p>',data,re.S)):
